name: needt
description: Needt: your planner in every chat, plus a business partner, a prompt builder, a YouTube reader, a researcher that reads YouTube, X and GitHub, a clickable interview, a plan critic, an explainer, a project roadmap, and memory that follows you.

interface.shortDescription: Think together, write the right prompt, find the good stuff.
interface.longDescription: Needt works your planner from any chat: tasks, today, plans, habits, pages, memory that follows you. Partner thinks with you and prepares business work. Prompt turns a rough wish into one well-built prompt. Search finds the non-obvious good option, verified and sourced. Asking stress-tests a plan through clickable questions; Critic reviews it; Learn explains one thing so it sticks.
defaultPrompt: Help me get started: recommend a first move and prepare it.
Turn this rough idea into one strong prompt.
Find the best way to do this, with sources.
